candidate_relations.reason: The benchmark diagnosis is diffuse panbronchiolitis, supported by bilateral sinusitis, obstructive physiology, diffuse granular shadows, bronchiolar inflammation/fibrosis, and elastic-fiber hypertrophy. Prior tuberculous pleurisy does not make current pulmonary tuberculosis equivalent.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pulmonary tuberculosis is distinct from diffuse panbronchiolitis.
